# Omapresent 0.1.1

A patch release for sharing the audience display on a call or recording.

- The audience view is now an independent native Wayland top-level, so a
  compositor or share portal can offer it on its own rather than only exposing
  the editor window.
- The README, the welcome deck and the agent skill now explain which source to
  pick: the window titled `<deck title> — Omapresent`, or `Omapresent` when the
  deck has no title. Do not pick `aquamarine - WAYLAND-1` — that is the outer
  compositor output, not the deck.

Everything else is unchanged from 0.1.0. No deck, settings or skill changes are
needed to upgrade.
